# Deterministic Output in Normalize

The normalize function is a pure function of (facts, current, config), with no clock, no randomness, and no unordered iteration. It never removes entities (removals handled elsewhere), and LLM-derived facts never assign identity.

To guarantee deterministic, reproducible IR output (addressing requirements in normalize.md §9 and ADR-004) and to separate responsibilities between normalization (only creates/updates) and diff/removal logic.
